title: 又
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved final source for L167 又. Latest origin/main contains L164 擦; L167 depends on unmerged L165 先 and L166 洗, so do not merge production JSON until all dependencies are present in latest origin/main. Provisional learned chars are 先 and 洗. Use Taiwan Traditional Chinese and Taiwan zhuyin only; use 裡 not 裏. Do not add unlearned display characters such as 才, 洗完, 乾, 淨, 毛, 巾, 鞋櫃, 客, 廳, 亂, 髒, 歉, 道. Images must be square 1:1 compositions with centered meaning-bearing objects and safe margins, use L058 style anchors, and contain no text, numbers, signs, letters, zhuyin, labels, logos, or watermarks. Audio must be standalone OpenAI charAudio, whole-sentence AI audio, independent G02 prefix/suffix from exact fragments, and independent G05 wrong-choice whole-sentence audio.
